---
applyTo: "core/**/*.py,utils/**/*.py,config.py,config_migrate.py,error_handler.py,cli.py"
---

Read `AGENTS.md`, `docs/architecture/overview.md`, `PROJECT_STRUCTURE.md`, `docs/testing/TESTING.md` and the matching row in `docs/DOCUMENTATION_POLICY.md` before editing backend code.

Backend behavior changes normally require tests and a review of user documentation. Changes involving network services, cookies/credentials, persisted data, update logic or external components additionally require privacy/security/migration/release documentation review as mapped by the policy.
